title: BaselineManifest
description: Schema for the baseline manifest file at baselines/manifest.json. Tracks all captured baseline suites, their provenance, model version, and integrity checksums. Acts as the authoritative index for the statistical engine when looking up baselines for regression comparison.

manifest_version.description: Semantic version of this manifest file's schema.

baseline_protocol_version.description: Version of the baseline generation protocol used to create this manifest.

model_version.description: The Anthropic API model version against which all baselines in this manifest were captured. All agents in this manifest must have been captured against this model version.

judge_model_version.description: The model version used for LLM-as-Judge evaluation across all baselines in this manifest.

created_timestamp_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this manifest was first initialized.

last_updated_timestamp_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent update to this manifest.

capture_sessions.description: Log of all capture sessions that contributed to this manifest. Provides audit trail for multi-session captures.

agents.description: Per-agent baseline status and suite references. Keys are agent names.

integrity.description: Integrity verification metadata for the full manifest.

manifest_checksum.description: SHA-256 checksum of all suite checksums concatenated in agent-alphabetical order. Recomputed on every manifest update.

total_run_count.description: Total number of run records across all agents and prompts in this manifest (including error runs).

total_valid_run_count.description: Total number of valid (api_error=null, evaluation_error=null) run records.

total_prompt_count.description: Total number of canonical prompt/agent combinations with complete baselines.

refresh_history.description: Log of baseline refresh events. Empty for initial captures. Entries added by record_refresh.py.

quality_gate_history.description: Log of baseline quality gate checks run against this manifest.

notes.description: Optional free-text notes about this baseline capture (reasons, known issues, context).

CaptureSession.description: Record of a single capture session that contributed to this manifest.

started_timestamp_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this session started.

completed_timestamp_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this session completed. Null if session was interrupted.

git_hash_at_capture.description: Git HEAD commit hash at the start of this capture session.

agents_captured.description: Agent names for which capture was initiated in this session.

interruption_reason.description: Reason for interruption if status is 'interrupted' or 'failed'.

resumed_by_session.description: Session ID that resumed this session, if applicable.

AgentBaselineEntry.description: Baseline status and suite reference for one target agent.

agent_name.description: Agent name matching the parent object key.

status.description: Baseline capture status for this agent.

agent_definition_path.description: Repo-relative path to the agent definition file.

agent_definition_git_hash.description: Git commit hash of the agent definition file used in this baseline.

suite_file_path.description: Repo-relative path to the agent's baseline suite JSON file. Null if not yet captured.

suite_id.description: Suite ID from the baseline suite file. Null if not yet captured.

suite_checksum.description: SHA-256 checksum of the suite file. Null if not yet captured. Used for manifest integrity verification.

prompt_count.description: Number of canonical test prompts captured for this agent.

valid_run_count.description: Total valid (non-error) run count for this agent across all prompts.

overall_median_composite.description: Median weighted composite score across all valid runs for this agent. Null if not yet captured.

overall_pass_rate_at_0_92.description: Fraction of valid runs scoring >= 0.92 for this agent. Null if not yet captured.

quality_gate_passed.description: Result of baseline quality gate (median >= 0.65). Null if quality gate has not been run.

capture_completed_timestamp_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when capture for this agent completed. Null if in progress.

refresh_required_reason.description: Reason why a baseline refresh is required for this agent. Null if no refresh is needed.

RefreshEvent.description: Record of a baseline refresh event.

refresh_timestamp_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the refresh was initiated.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason code for the refresh.

reason_comment.description: Human-readable comment explaining the refresh reason.

old_model_version.description: Model version of the baselines being replaced.

new_model_version.description: Model version of the new baselines being captured.

agents_refreshed.description: List of agent names for which baselines are being refreshed.

archive_path.description: Repo-relative path where old baseline data was archived.

QualityGateEvent.description: Record of a baseline quality gate check.

checked_timestamp_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the quality gate check.

min_median_threshold.description: Minimum median composite score threshold used for this check.

results_per_agent.description: Quality gate result per agent. Keys are agent names.

overall_passed.description: True if all agents passed the quality gate.
